Summary: [Infra] Prepare AWS: S3 state bucket and GitHub OIDC role
Description: Create the S3 bucket for Terraform state and the IAM role GitHub Actions assumes through OIDC. Done when: bucket exists and the role ARN is noted.

Summary: [Infra] Clone the Terraform repo and make it your own
Description: Clone, delete .git, git init, set Git identity, push to your own repo. Add GitHub secret AWS_OIDC_ARN. Done when: your repo has the code and the secret.

Summary: [Infra] Pipeline job 1: terraform init, fmt and validate
Description: Push to main. Done when: the init & validate job is green.

Summary: [Infra] Pipeline job 2: security scans (tfsec + SonarQube)
Description: Review tfsec and SonarQube findings. Done when: both scans ran and findings are reviewed.

Summary: [Infra] Pipeline job 3: terraform plan and apply
Description: Creates VPC, EKS (5 x t2.medium), EBS/EFS storage, NGINX ingress, cert-manager, Argo CD and uploads kubeconfig to S3. Done when: apply succeeds.

Summary: [Infra] Pipeline job 4: verify the deployment
Description: Cluster ACTIVE, nodes Ready, cert-manager, ClusterIssuer, NGINX load balancer, Argo CD, EFS and kubeconfig in S3 all pass. Done when: the verify job is green.

Summary: [Infra] Argo CD: DNS record, ingress and admin login
Description: Create the argocd CNAME to the load balancer, apply manifests/argocd-ingress.yaml, get the admin password. Done when: https://argocd.<domain> opens with a valid certificate and you can log in.

Summary: [CI] Clone the app and k8s-file repos and make them your own
Description: Clone both repos, create your own, push. Replace the AWS account ID, k8s-file repo and domain with yours. Done when: both of your repos contain your values.

Summary: [CI] Set up the self-hosted GitHub Actions runner
Description: Register an EC2 runner (50 GiB disk, Docker installed) to the app repo, or switch runs-on to ubuntu-latest. Done when: the runner shows Idle in GitHub.

Summary: [CI] Add the CI secrets and variables
Description: In the app repo add secrets AWS_ROLE_ARN and K8S_REPO_TOKEN, and variable AWS_REGION. Done when: all three are set.

Summary: [CI] Build the first service image
Description: Set the build list to one service and push. Done when: the image is in ECR tagged with the run number and k8s-file has a commit with the new tag.

Summary: [CI] Build all 24 service images
Description: Add the remaining services to the list, in batches. Done when: every service has an image in ECR.

Summary: [CD] Create DNS records for the application
Description: CNAME records to the load balancer for shop, grafana, jaeger, prometheus and logs. Done when: all five names resolve.

Summary: [CD] Create the Kubernetes secrets
Description: Run create-secrets.sh and create ai-secrets with the Claude API key. Done when: the secrets exist; nothing sensitive is in Git.

Summary: [CD] Connect the k8s-file repo to Argo CD and apply the root app
Description: Add the repo in Argo CD (if private), then kubectl apply -f argocd/root-app.yaml. Done when: 6 apps appear in Argo CD.

Summary: [CD] Layer 00-base: namespaces, storage class, issuers
Description: Done when: app is Synced and Healthy.

Summary: [CD] Layer 10-data: PostgreSQL, Valkey, Kafka
Description: Done when: app is Synced and Healthy and all data pods are Running.

Summary: [CD] Layer 20-logging: OpenSearch and Dashboards
Description: Done when: Synced and Healthy; https://logs.<domain> asks for a login.

Summary: [CD] Layer 30-observability: OTel Collector, Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana
Description: Done when: Synced and Healthy; grafana, jaeger and prometheus URLs open.

Summary: [CD] Layer 40-app: the 17 shop services
Description: Done when: Synced and Healthy; https://shop.<domain> loads.

Summary: [CD] Layer 50-ai-assistant: chatbot, agent, MCP
Description: Done when: Synced and Healthy; https://shop.<domain>/chatbot/ loads.

Summary: [Test] TLS certificates for every URL
Description: All 6 hosts serve a valid Let's Encrypt certificate. Done when: kubectl get certificate -A shows READY=True everywhere.

Summary: [Test] Shop end-to-end: browse, cart, checkout
Description: Browse products, add to cart, place an order. Done when: the order completes and the email service logs the confirmation.

Summary: [Test] AI chatbot answers and uses shop tools
Description: Ask a general question and 'list the products you have'. Done when: both answer correctly.

Summary: [Test] Observability: traces, metrics and logs
Description: Find the order trace in Jaeger (checkout / PlaceOrder), view Grafana dashboards, search logs in OpenSearch. Done when: all three show the test order.

Summary: [Test] GitOps: a code change deploys automatically
Description: Change a small piece of frontend code and push. Done when: the new image is built, k8s-file is updated and Argo CD rolls it out with no manual step.

Summary: [Test] Failure drill with a feature flag
Description: Turn on a flagd flag (e.g. paymentFailure), place an order, find the error in Jaeger and Grafana, then turn it off. Done when: the failure was detected and recovered.

Summary: [Test] Teardown: terraform destroy
Description: When finished, run the destroy job to remove all AWS resources. Done when: no EKS, load balancer or NAT gateway remains (check the AWS bill).
